action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if (not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or
        not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or
        not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray)):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D matrices")
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if shape[0] == 0 or shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be nonempty")
    if not (np.isfinite(logp_with_result).all() and
            np.isfinite(logp_call_only).all() and
            np.isfinite(logp_no_call).all()):
        raise ValueError("All input values must be finite")
    if not (np.all(logp_with_result <= 0) and
            np.all(logp_call_only <= 0) and
            np.all(logp_no_call <= 0)):
        raise ValueError("All log probabilities must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    # Compute total log probabilities per candidate (sum over future horizon)
    total_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    total_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    total_no = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
    # Compute margin: improvement over the best alternative (max logprob)
    best_alternative = np.maximum(total_call, total_no)
    margins = total_with - best_alternative
    keep_mask = margins >= tau_filter
    return (keep_mask, margins)
